company_info.description: One of Malaysia's largest palm oil producers

evidence.conclusion: Plantation boundaries are stable with no evidence of new deforestation. Based on Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite data analysis, vegetation index changes over the 5-year period are within normal ranges.

compliance.eudr: ✅ Compliant with EU EUDR regulations (no deforestation evidence)
compliance.rspo: ⚠️ RSPO certification partially suspended (due to social issues)

key_events.event: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) issued a Withhold Release Order (WRO) against FGV based on forced labor allegations
key_events.impact: Palm oil and its products from FGV were detained at all U.S. ports of entry, prohibiting entry into the U.S. market. This resulted in an estimated annual export loss of approximately $200 million for FGV, causing significant financial and international reputation damage.

key_events.event: FGV set a target to lift the U.S. import ban by the end of 2024 and invested over 100 million Ringgit in worker recruitment fee compensation
key_events.impact: Demonstrates the company's active remediation efforts, with plans to submit a petition in June 2024. However, the ban remains in place, and export restrictions continue to affect company performance and supply chain partners' risk assessments.

key_events.event: FGV officially submitted a petition to modify the WRO to U.S. CBP
key_events.impact: FGV submitted the petition on June 30, 2024, demonstrating remediation commitment. However, CBP review typically takes 6-12 months. Short-term risks remain, and downstream companies need to continue monitoring progress.

traditional_rating.description: Traditional ratings are vague; BB rating cannot clearly distinguish whether issues are environmental or social, and update cycles are up to six months

metrics.foreign_workers: Approximately 70% of workforce are foreign workers

upstream.name: FGV Holdings Berhad
upstream.production_capacity: Annual production of approximately 4.5 million tons of palm oil

midstream.name: COFCO Group
midstream.exposure: FGV accounts for approximately 18% of COFCO's palm oil procurement (estimated)
midstream.dependency: Medium dependency, but FGV is one of the important suppliers

regulations.eu: EU EUDR regulations (effective December 2024) require zero-deforestation proof and due diligence; non-compliant companies face fines up to 4% of annual turnover
regulations.us: U.S. CBP has issued an import ban on FGV, prohibiting any goods containing FGV products from entering; violations will result in detention and fines. FGV submitted a petition to modify the WRO in June 2024, but review takes 6-12 months
regulations.china: Chinese consumers are increasingly concerned about sustainability; green-certified products command a 5-10% premium, and brand reputation risks are rising

market_impact.us: Extremely High Risk - Currently still banned from import (remediation ongoing but not yet lifted)

impact_alert.message:
⚠️ URGENT RISK ALERT! Your supplier FGV's high-risk S indicator has triggered the U.S. CBP import ban (2020-present). Although FGV submitted a modification petition in June 2024 and invested over 100 million Ringgit in remediation, the ban remains in effect. This means:

1. Any products containing FGV palm oil still cannot enter the U.S. market
2. EU EUDR regulations will conduct strict reviews of supply chain transparency
3. International brand customers may require supplier changes due to reputation risks
4. CBP review takes 6-12 months; short-term risks persist

It is recommended to immediately initiate supplier ESG audits, evaluate alternatives, and continuously monitor FGV's remediation progress.

risk_scenarios.impact: FGV petition fails and ban remains long-term. U.S. market completely closed, EU customers suspend procurement, annual losses could reach $50 million
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Immediately initiate supplier diversification, reduce FGV dependency to below 5% within 6 months

risk_scenarios.impact: FGV lifts ban in first half of 2025 but requires continuous monitoring. Increased compliance costs and audit requirements for downstream customers
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Establish long-term supplier ESG monitoring mechanism and prepare backup supplier plans

risk_scenarios.impact: FGV successfully lifts ban in Q4 2024 with full remediation recognized. Supply chain returns to normal with enhanced transparency
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Continue supporting FGV's remediation and incorporate ESG clauses into long-term contracts
